ety.text: Inherited from Middle Hindi ٿهيس (ṭhys /⁠ṭhes⁠/) (c. 1682), derived from Proto-New Indo-Aryan *ठेस्स- (ṭhĕssa-), whence also ठेसना (ṭhesnā, “to crami n”). Also related to ठोसना (ṭhosnā, “to cram in”), ठोस (ṭhos, “dense, solid”), ठूँसना (ṭhū̃snā), ढोस (ḍhos, “thrust”), ठेलना (ṭhelnā, “to push”).

s.g: unit of weight, generally equal to 12 grams
